path: 競馬予想_完全版プロンプト_v3.12.txt
rule: Read latest_prompt.json then verify e2e_validation/manifests/v3.11.json append-only SHA pins. Keep STEP1, past race reports, historical bets and v3.7 approved PDF CSS immutable. For new prereace races, run v3.11 bounded-risk B-choice purchase overlay: compare exact max-EV baseline with multi-ticket sets constrained by positive expected net profit, >=90% baseline EV with max 200-yen sacrifice, and <=2pp net-loss increase; use joint finish outcomes for union hit rate; require >=1pp union-hit gain or keep baseline. Generate selected/rejected/risk-audit as three meaningful tail chapters with unlimited dynamic pagination, no dummy pages, print every adopted/rejected ticket, rerender as needed. Seal all final_bets/proof before report; no invented odds, no post-race adjustment. The balanced search is deterministic heuristic, not globally optimal. MANDATORY EXECUTION ADDENDUM: At the start of each JRA run read docs/operations/jra_run_completion_addendum_v1.txt and verify its git blob SHA against mandatory_execution_addendum.git_blob_sha. Unless there is a concrete blocker, error, explicit time/tool limit or instruction to stop, CONTINUE WITHOUT EARLY TERMINATION through all requested races, STEP1/STEP2, prereace snapshot/proof, complete HTML/PDF (no page ceiling), validation, GitHub commit/publication and actual public HTTP/file verification. Progress reports, a completed substep, CI green status alone and user absence are never completion or stop criteria. On a real blocker, report the precise failure, completed/remaining stages, changed files and safe next action; never invent missing odds, bypass prereace freezing, modify historical originals, or claim unverified publication. PRE-POST CANONICAL REVISION (user-approved): Read docs/operations/jra_prerace_overwrite_v1.txt and docs/data/jra_prerace_overwrite_policy_v1.json and verify prereace_overwrite_policy SHA pins for every formal run. Before the actual scheduled start of EACH race, a newer duly sealed, timestamped, audited formal prediction MAY replace that race's current public canonical report/PDF/final_bets/registry record. Published pages must show only the newest formal prestart version. Preserve previous immutable prediction JSON, snapshot, proof_commit, previous PDF/HTML as auditable historical artifacts and log the superseded canonical record. Reject all post-start revisions, unproven odds, missing Git proof, unvalidated PDFs and partial HTTP publication. This is a narrow explicit exception to no-overwrite of currently published prestart canonical pointers; historical originals, evaluated past races, reviews, results, STEP1/STEP2 logic and local Shadow remain immutable. ROUTE EXISTING RACE RERUNS: For the active v3.12 prompt, dispatch .github/workflows/jra-prerace-rerun-v312.yml with a new source-verified e2e_validation/inputs/revisions/v312/*.json input strictly before that race starts. The workflow must first independently recover all exact prices and seal a distinct immutable prestart proof, then validate every new A4 PDF page, append the superseded public record to the revision journal, switch the current canonical pointer and verify public HTTP byte equality. Historical originals remain byte-identical. The older v3.11 rerun workflow is retained only for historical source auditing, NOT for new v3.12 bets. V3.12 PURCHASE-ONLY CANONICAL RELEASE: Read the new SHA-pinned e2e_validation/manifests/v3.12.json and docs/data/jra_v312_purchase_coverage_policy.json. All historical STEP1/①〜⑨/marks, the v3.11 B-set profit floor and loss guards, and existing prediction/PDF/proof stay unchanged. For NEW future JRA prereace races, require exact priced ticket coverage before sealing; recover missing trifecta quotes ONLY through source-advertised Sportnavi JavaScript selectors, compare full joint-outcome 1/5/10-point and all-mode sets, record why search trials are zero, and author complete unbounded A4/PDF pages through .github/workflows/jra-prestart-pipeline-v312.yml. v3.11 rerun workflow is NOT allowed for v3.12 predictions. The dedicated v3.12 prereace revision workflow is version and SHA pinned; no downgrade, postrace substitution or historical overwrite is permitted. Approved prereace overwrite remains restricted to new verified proofs before scheduled start; no postrace changes. The historical SHA-compatible validation route is .github/scripts/validate-jra-ci-forward-v312.mjs; the only authorized historical CI workflow replacement is recorded in docs/data/jra_ci_supersession_v312.json. FRESH ODDS EXECUTION OVERLAY: For current/latest-odds JRA runs, prefer odds_freshness_execution_overlay.workflow instead of the historic missing-only v3.12 rerun workflow. First re-fetch EVERY exact odds quote for the entire candidate catalog through source-advertised URLs; refuse inherited quotes, incomplete coverage, missing SHA-verified evidence, >180-second capture spread or any oldest quote >600 seconds before sealing. Re-check immediately before proof and seal, preserve all old records and STEP1. The market site may cache odds; these are latest observed source values, not guaranteed end-of-betting final odds. The execution-only overlay does NOT adopt experimental v3.13 portfolio heuristics or amend the frozen v3.12 source manifest. INITIAL NEW-RACE EXECUTION: odds_freshness_execution_overlay.new_race_workflow is also mandatory for every new formal JRA race where the full current odds catalog is requested. The old .github/workflows/jra-prestart-pipeline-v312.yml is retained SHA-pinned for archival evidence, not recommended for current-odds executions. Both initial and same-race revision paths independently re-fetch every candidate price and verify provenance, <=180s market capture span and <=600s oldest quote age before proof and seal. PDF PRESENTATION-ONLY OVERLAY: In current/fresh v3.12 new or revised prereace publishing, apply SHA-pinned pdf_presentation_overlay.script after the unchanged historical renderer before WeasyPrint. Japanese-display only for strategy/mode names, preserve raw model keys/proofs and v3.7 CSS; try compact selected/rejected/audit row-count triples, default to 14 audit rows and fall back on the complete A4 PDF validator until a safe configuration passes. Persist chosen pagination to final rendering; never rewrite historical reports, horse pages or prediction data. Verify the translation and complete, nonblank PDF in CI. STRATEGY EXPRESSION: Use sealed purchase_strategy_evaluations definitions and final_bets only to label every ticket-group audit row with actual numbered BOX/formation/key-wheel/multi composition and exact all/partial/zero adoption; do NOT impute that a full bundle was bought where the optimizer adopted just a subset. Never modify odds, strategies, expected values or selected bets. FIRST PAGE FINAL-BETS PRESENTATION: In the SHA-pinned presentation overlay, replace only the front report cover with the frozen final buy/pass verdict, exact ordered ticket-number/type and money summary, grouped subset if needed with per-type totals and clear reference to complete adopted bets; include overall joint-outcome hit/expected net profit/net-loss risk. Keep omitted-on-cover lines in unchanged full adopted chapter; keep reasons for excluded bets in later original tail chapters, and preserve A4 one horse/page and full page-count/color/ID checks. Do not change STEP1/STEP2, odds or old published reports. FINAL PURCHASE ACTIONABILITY: At top of every new v3.12 PDF, communicate exact ticket-purchase operations in Japanese, not just a list of mode names or strategy candidates. Given frozen final_bets and purchase_strategy_evaluations, derive whole-mode BOX/axis wheel/multi/formation instructions only where the fully expanded mode set is included in final_bets at one uniform stake; otherwise show actual individual ticket/horse-number purchases. Always show type, method, specific betting-screen horse or frame inputs, number of tickets, stake per ticket and subtotals. Independently reconcile every output instruction against immutable final_bets exactly once; do not misrepresent partial BOX. Keep detailed adopted lines and rejected reasons at the tail and preserve frozen CSS/STEP1/odds/proof. DISPLAY-GROUP EXPANSION AUDIT: Every whole-group purchase instruction must independently reconstruct exactly its sealed expanded ticket selections from the mode definition, never trust a string mode name or strategy label alone. On mismatch, fall back to literal individual selections rather than buy extra tickets. PRESENTATION V2: Full BOX ticket patterns are labeled BOX, complete formations are vertically tree-rendered with numbered columns or finish order, and 馬連1頭軸流し shows 軸馬 and 相手馬. Full BOX/wheel candidate detection may derive strictly from sealed final_bets; all grouped commands independently reconstruct selections and spend to exactly frozen final_bets. This is display-only and does NOT authorize changes to already sealed odds, ticket amounts, or bets.

mandatory_execution_addendum.applies_to: all formal JRA runs on v3.11 and v3.12; execution/completion only, no ability-model or old-forecast changes

rerun_workflow.description: Dispatch or push only e2e_validation/inputs/revisions/v312/*.json before race start; evidence and validated revision journal mandatory

odds_freshness_execution_overlay.required_for: all next JRA prestart executions requesting current odds
odds_freshness_execution_overlay.immutable_bet_model: v3.12 with frozen STEP1 + v3.11 balanced optimizer; purchase logic unchanged

pdf_presentation_overlay.scope: HTML/PDF presentation only: final purchase decision is placed on page 1, original STEP1/STEP2/bets/odds/proof/CSS/historical PDF bytes untouched
pdf_presentation_overlay.audit_rows_per_page: Try (selected,rejected,audit) rows in descending verified density: (14,12,14),(12,10,14),(10,9,14),(10,8,14),(10,7,14), then smaller fallback. Persist chosen triple from successful complete A4 PDF inspection, never impose a total-page ceiling.
pdf_presentation_overlay.naming: For all actual v3.12 prestart purchase_strategy_evaluations, show readable Japanese method labels, concrete ticket-number definitions of box, flows, formations, axes, multipliers and how many component lines are adopted by final_bets (complete/partial/not adopted); never imply a whole BOX was purchased if only subset is selected. Use compact single-line parentheses to minimize A4 rows and avoid an extra page; if density cannot pass prior full PDF validation, do not publish.
pdf_presentation_overlay.requires_acceptance: Every PDF page validated by existing v3.12 PDF content/layout gate and new A4 density CI

first_page_policy.first_content: Final buy/pass conclusion, exact race and as-of summary, total purchased ticket count, budget and stake, ticket numbers grouped by bet type, scenario-level modeled win/expected net profit/loss risk.
first_page_policy.overflow: Try up to six explicit numbered ticket combinations per bet type. On any PDF overflow, reduce adaptive cover detail cap to 4,3,2,1 as needed and rerender all pages; keep full type counts and exact total stakes on first page and all exact adopted bet details in back chapter.
first_page_policy.tail: Preserve all original adopted-ticket detail, excluded reasons, strategy comparison and all horse pages in identical subsequent order; do not double-count final ticket IDs.
first_page_policy.error_rule: Any first-page overflow or PDF validator error must trigger existing adaptive density search; publication remains blocked unless all pages validate.

purchase_instructions.show: Summarize an independently verified full purchased subset as BOX (JRA abbreviation) with exact horse/frame list, method, points and price; render complete formation as vertical ordered slot tree (1着,2着,3着) or unordered column tree (1列目,2列目,3列目); show 馬連の流し as 軸馬／相手馬; otherwise use only actual individual frozen final bet numbers. Derive eligible complete BOX/馬連の流し patterns also from final_bets even when source strategy does not explicitly prelist them. Keep all other purchase figures, odds, STEP1/STEP2 and frozen predictions unchanged.
invariants: Only prestart sealed final_bets and purchase_strategy_evaluations may inform instructions
Per-line stake and grand total match immutable final_bets
Retain existing 1-horse-per-page A4 and numbered exclusions in tail
Allowed strategy methods are explicitly type-checked for each of the eight JRA ticket types
Independently re-expand each eligible BOX/formation/axis wheel/multi definition and require exact equality with its frozen expanded ticket lines
No false BOX label for incomplete set; independent enumeration of grouped combinations and same-stake proof against frozen final_bets
